hints.title: Edge Contribution by Group
hints.text: For any edge (u, v), removing it splits the structured search into two connected components T_u and T_v.

hints.title: Group Pair Multiplications
hints.text: For a fixed group g, if T_u contains c_g nodes of group g and the whole tree has total_g nodes of group g, then the edge separates c_g * (total_g - c_g) pairs in that group.

hints.title: Post-Order Tree Traversal
hints.text: Use a post-order tree DFS to count group members in each subtree, summing c_g * (total_g - c_g) across all groups and all edges.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

class Solution:
    def totalInteractionCost(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], groups: list[int]) -> int:
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v in edges:
            adj[u].append(v)
            adj[v].append(u)
        
        total_counts = Counter(groups)
        total_cost = 0
        
        def dfs(u: int, p: int) -> dict[int, int]:
            nonlocal total_cost
            sub_counts = defaultdict(int)
            sub_counts[groups[u]] += 1
            
            for v in adj[u]:
                if v != p:
                    child_counts = dfs(v, u)
                    for g, cnt in child_counts.items():
                        total_cost += cnt * (total_counts[g] - cnt)
                        sub_counts[g] += cnt
            return sub_counts
        
        dfs(0, -1)
        return total_cost
```

complexity.notes: Here G is the number of distinct groups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing all pairs shortest paths takes O(n^2) or O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Merges subtree frequency dictionaries during DFS.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects edge-centric contribution counting rather than path-centric counting.
